entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I... I need some help. I have this jersey I bought, and I'm just so confused about what to do. I think I need to send it back.
I can certainly look into that for you. To start, could I get your name and order number?
It's Sarah Gable. The order number is... uh, hold on... VF88-9102. I tried looking online but the pages were so complicated.

Thank you, Sarah. I see your order for the Pro-Line Jersey, delivered 37 days ago. So I can best help you, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
Oh, it's not broken or anything. I just got the wrong size. It's way too tight on me, and I don't think I can ride in it comfortably. I was hoping to exchange it.
Okay, so it's a sizing issue. I understand completely. Let me just pull up our current return policy for you.
Is it going to be a problem? It's been over a month. I'm just not very good at this stuff. Can't you just help me?
No need to worry, Sarah. I'm here to help. I'm just checking the details for this specific item... Okay, I see here that for standard apparel like this jersey, we have a 90-day return window.
Yes, absolutely. Since you received it 37 days ago, you are well within that 90-day period. We can definitely process an exchange for a different size or a full refund, whichever you prefer.
Oh, thank goodness! An exchange for the next size up would be perfect. Thank you so much, Charlie.

You're very welcome, Sarah. I'm happy I could clear that up for you. I'm sending an email to you right now with a pre-paid return label and instructions on how to complete the exchange. Just follow the steps there, and we'll get the correct size sent out to you as soon as we receive the original jersey.
